title: Token bucket for driver location pings
name: Driver ping limiter

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code throttles location pings per driver? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A new driver sends 5 pings in the same millisecond. How many are accepted?
choices: 0, because the first ping has no prior state

questions.prompt: Right after its bucket empties, a driver is denied. It retries every 100 ms. What happens to its retries?
choices: Each denied retry resets the refill, so it is locked out indefinitely
The first retry after about 1 second is accepted
Retries are accepted immediately because denial stores no state
It must wait burst / ratePerSec = 3 seconds

questions.prompt: Pings with lat = 200 arrive rapidly from one driver. How do they interact with the limiter?
choices: They consume tokens and then get 400
They get 429 once the bucket empties
They are rejected with 400 before the limiter is consulted and consume no tokens
They are clamped to 90 and accepted
